description: Start Notify agent signup or key recovery without the dashboard. Sends a 6-digit email OTP. No NOTIFY_API_KEY required. Ask the user to paste the code, then call bootstrap_confirm. Requires acceptTerms: true (https://notify.cx/terms).

acceptTerms.description: Must be true — user accepts Terms and AUP

email.description: User email for the Notify account

name: bootstrap_start
